name_note: GTDB places this species in the genus Eubacterium_I and marks this lineage _A; the literature and NCBI use the name Eubacterium ramulus.

sentences.text: Eubacterium ramulus is described as a gut commensal microbe.
A study identified Eubacterium ramulus as a bacterium that sulfonates hydroxy fatty acids, and characterised the enzyme ErSULT that performs this sulfonation.
In a cohort of 6419 participants followed for incident pneumonia, the relative abundance of Eubacterium_I ramulus was inversely associated with pneumonia risk.
A metagenomic study of hepatitis E reported Eubacterium ramulus among commensals depleted in a severity-associated signature.
